title: Configuration-driven product compatibility policy
summary: Made product availability, retirement and import constraints explicit in shared policy.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2026-07-17. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Centralized supported/retired product-version decisions in configurable policy and integrated import/retirement behavior and subsection availability gates.
Made compatibility rules explicit across application flows, reducing dependence on scattered hardcoded product assumptions.
Later lifecycle/epoch guards in the shared data service include other authors; static policy inspection does not prove every product revision was exercised.

notes: 2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
